_comment: Tensors the pinned llama.cpp build never places on the GPU under any load mode, by architecture and exact name.
The fit subtracts their bytes from the file, because pricing them against the GPU budget refuses a model the machine serves.
Hand-reviewed at the pin, like families.json: a model's code flags a tensor TENSOR_READ_LAZY in llama-model.cpp, and llama-arch.cpp gives it op GET_ROWS on the input layer.
The Hub shelf keys on the listing's architecture, which it has before any header read, so an architecture belongs here only when its files carry such a tensor.
per_layer_token_embd.weight: the per-layer input table of the per-layer-embedding architectures. 28,800,138,240 bytes in Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Q4_K_XL-DN4.
